messages:
anya: Heads up 1: sales backlog: several customers asked for a "30-day launch buffer" — temporary higher throughput and clearer billing visibility for the first month after signup. Need a quick decision on shape and rollout.

mike: Implementation note: prefer a per-account ephemeral quota object (start_ts + expiry) + route caps. Rolling 30-day window avoids billing-cycle confusion.

jordan: Customers want it to be opt-out and visible in Console. Also they want a clear invoice label so there's no surprise.

sylvia: Accounting/legal prefer a promo SKU so we can attach metadata and make it auditable. Draft label: "Launch Buffer (promo)". I'll draft clause: "Temporary elevated throughput for 30 days from activation; provided as a promotional benefit to eligible accounts."

rex: Ops: runtime risk if a lot of newbies launch same week. Suggest per-route soft caps and a global concurrent promo cap, plus telemetry: promo_request_ratio, p95_delta, and promo_extension_count.

mike: Agree. We'll add a token-bucket limiter for promo traffic and a soft-throttle threshold that kicks in before queueing. Feature-flag rollout plan sounds necessary.

anya: Proposed customer-facing rules: (a) 30-day rolling buffer, (b) default ON for self-serve, opt-out via Console or support, (c) one manual extension allowed (max +15 days) via Sales, (d) visible promo line item on invoices.

sylvia: Also add: invoice metadata invoice_meta.promo_code = LAUNCHBUF30 and audit log for manual extensions (who approved + reason). I'll prepare T&Cs snippet.

jordan: Pilot plan: 6 customers (3 startups, 2 mid-market, 1 internal) for 2-week early rollout. I'll own opt-ins and comms.

mike: Canary plan: 2% traffic tomorrow for 24h -> check p95 latency < 1.7x and error delta < 4% then ramp. I'll post dashboards.

rex: Add a guard: if global promo_active_count > 500 then stop auto-on for new signups and route new customers to support-managed activation to control load.

anya: Decision summary: build promo SKU "Launch Buffer (promo)" + Console toggle default ON, admin API + audit logs, rolling 30-day window, manual 1x extension by Sales, rollout behind feature flag with canary. Action items: Mike - API + rate-limiter + dashboards; Sylvia - invoice metadata + T&Cs snippet; Jordan - pilot recruitment + comms; Rex - global guard + telemetry thresholds; Anya - update PRD and acceptance criteria.

mike: noted. will share canary link when available.

sylvia: I'll post draft clause in #legal by EOD.

anya: Thanks all. Reconvene after 24h canary metrics. :thumbsup:
